video.title: AI欧腐《室友每晚给我热牛奶，然后爬上了我的床》
video.desc:
Felix can't sleep—until his hockey-star roommate Caleb pours him warm milk nightly. But he wakes with sore lips and strange marks... so he dumps the milk. That night, Caleb climbs into his bed: "You belong to me." Expose his obsessed roommate—or surrender to a desire he can't deny. One glass of milk. One secret. One obsession neither can escape.
Felix 失眠成疾——直到冰球明星室友 Caleb 开始每晚给他倒一杯热牛奶。可他醒来时，嘴唇发疼，身上还有奇怪的痕迹……于是他把牛奶倒掉了。当晚，Caleb 爬上了他的床："你是我的。"
是揭穿这个偏执的室友，还是向一份无法否认的渴望投降？
一杯牛奶。一个秘密。一场谁也逃不掉的执念。
